Notes to Consolidated Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026

2 "The unaudited consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 have been reviewed by the Audit Committee and taken on record by Board of Directors in their respective meeting held on November 14, 2026. The review as required under Regulation 33 of SEBI (Listing Obligation and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (as amended), has been carried out by the Statutory Auditors.

The Financial Results are available on the website of the Company viz, www.heromotors.com and on the website of National Stock Exchange of India Limited (www.nseindia.com) and Bombay Stock Exchange Limited (www.bseindia.com).
"

3 The unaudited consolidated financial results have been prepared in accordance with the recognition and measurement principles laid down in the lndian Accounting Standard 34 "lnterim Financial Reporting" ("Ind AS 34"), prescribed under Section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013 read with relevant rules issued thereunder and other accounting principles generally accepled in India and in compliance with Regulation 33 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations. 2015, as amended ("LODR Regulations"}, including relevant circulars issued by the SEBI from time to time.

4 "On November 21, 2025, Government of India notified provisions of the Code on Wages, 2019, the Industrial Relations Code, 2020, the Code on Social Security, 2020 and the Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020, (together referred to as “Labour Codes”) which consolidate multiple existing labour laws.

The Labour Codes, amongst other things introduced changes, including a uniform definition of wages and enhanced benefits relating to leave. The Company has assessed the financial implications of these changes based on the best information available, which has resulted in overall increase in gratuity liability arising out of past service cost and increase in leave liability by INR 195.88 lakhs. Considering the non-recurring nature of this impact arising out of an enactment of this new legislation, the Company has presented this incremental amount as an exceptional item in the year ended March 31, 2026. The Company continues to monitor the further developments to the Labour Codes and would provide for these developments appropriately.

Based on the rules notified to date, the Company does not expect any further material impact on its employee benefit obligations. The Company continues to monitor regulatory developments relating to the Labour Codes and will assess the impact of any future changes on the measurement of employee benefit liabilities as and when such developments occur."
5 The comparative figures for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2025 were not subject to the limited review by the statutory auditors of the Company and management has exercised necessary due diligence in preparing the financial results of these periods.
6 During the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, the Company has completed initial public offer (IPO) of equity shares of face value of INR 10 each at an issue price of INR 84 per share, comprising fresh issue of 7,14,28,571 shares aggregating to INR 60,000 lakhs and offer for sale of 4,70,23,809 shares by OP Munjal Holdings and 5,95,238 by Hero Cycles Limited aggregating to INR 40,000 lakhs. Pursuant to the IPO, the equity shares of the Company were listed on National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE) and BSE Limited (BSE) on September 23, 2026.

The total offer expenses are estimated to be INR 6,025 lakhs (exclusive of taxes) which are proportionately allocated between the selling shareholders and the Company as per respective offer size. 7 Pursuant to the shareholders agreements (SHA) between the Company and the investors of Compulsory convertible preference shares (CCPS), 2,09,71,941 number of CCPS have been converted, subsequent to the quarter end, into 2,09,71,941 number of equity shares of face value of Rs.10 each as approved by the Board of Directors of the Company in their meeting held on September 04, 2026.

8 During the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, 9,51,528 ESOPs and NIL ESOPs were granted by the Company's employee stock option scheme & also for the same quarter and Half year ended Septed 30, 2026, 9,51,528 and 34,79,045 ESOPs were exercised respectively by the employees of the Company.
9 The Board of Directors in its meeting held on May 01, 2026 declared an interim dividend of INR 0.32 per equity share aggregating to INR 1213.79 lakhs for the financial year 2026-27. The record date for determining the entitlement of shareholders to the said interim dividend was fixed on April 24, 2026. The interim dividend was paid to eligible shareholders within the prescribed timelines under applicable laws.
10 The Company got listed on September 23, 2026 and accordingly filed an application with the Registrar of Companies, Chandigarh on September 28, 2026 for modification of its Corporate Identification Number (CIN). As on the date of approval of these financial results, the application is under process and the existing Corporate Identification Number (CIN) continues to be disclosed in these financial results.
